Role Title: Customer Experience (CX) Specialist
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
Acme AI is engaging Customer Experience (CX) Specialists to contribute expertise in Shopping QA, Concierge Services, and Product Discovery for a customer-facing project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.
Scope of Work
1. Deliver detailed assessments of shopping experiences, identifying friction points and opportunities for improvement.
2. Evaluate and validate online product discovery journeys to ensure ease of selection and relevance for diverse users.
3. Provide real-time concierge service simulations and feedback to emulate best-in-class customer support scenarios.
4. Create, review, and refine conversational flows and written responses aimed at enhancing digital customer engagement.
5. Document and report usability findings, shopping QA results, and customer feedback patterns with clear, actionable insights.
Preferred Qualifications
1. Proven expertise in customer experience, shopping QA, or customer support within e-commerce or digital services.
2. Demonstrated ability to analyze and articulate complex customer journeys and identify improvement opportunities.
3. Experience offering personalized recommendations or concierge-style support in digital or retail environments.
4. Strong attention to detail when reviewing customer interactions, product discovery paths, and support scenarios.
5. Comfort working independently in a remote setting and contributing to collaborative, async-driven projects.
6. Familiarity with current trends in digital customer engagement, shopping platforms, or AI-based interaction is a plus.
